title: Duplicate identical return tags violate the single-return-tag documentation policy

ground_truth.statement: phpDocumentor specifies that a return tag MUST NOT occur more than once in a docblock. Two identical tags violate that documentation rule even though the PHP function executes correctly. The runtime control confirms the native return value.

provenance.derivation: Removed the unrelated untyped array parameter; identical int tags isolate the duplicate policy.

notes: Psalm reports InvalidDocblock. PHPStan and Mago are silent, retained as policy-comparison FN. The PHPStan predicate uses a distinctive duplicate-return message rather than inventing an identifier for a rule it does not currently emit. This is not a claim PHP execution is unsafe or that every analyzer must enforce all phpDocumentor constraints.
